assets.name: cliff-buttress
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated modular 3D terrain prop for a polished tropical adventure game. A single weathered volcanic CLIFF BUTTRESS, taller than wide, with four long angular eroded vertical ribs, deep narrow fissures, sloping shoulders and a small irregular grassy ledge on top. Warm taupe basalt faces, charcoal recesses, a few terracotta mineral planes, lush jade and lime moss following cracks and top edges. Large sculpted planar breaks and rounded bevels, no noisy tiny grit. An asymmetric 18-metre rock formation with a broad stable root, tapering high shoulder and lower projecting spur; useful repeated at different rotations to compose mountains. Fully visible 3/4 orthographic product render, neutral grey background, soft neutral studio light. ONE rock module only, no island, no water, no trees, no buildings, no text, no base pedestal.

assets.name: ridge-spine
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated modular 3D mountain rock for a polished tropical adventure game. A long LOW VOLCANIC RIDGE SPINE with three unequal jagged peaks along its length, a saddle notch, large diagonally fluted cliff planes, eroded buttressed lower edge, and broken bands of verdant jade grass and lime moss on upper ledges. About 23m long, 13m tall, 10m deep. Warm grey-taupe basalt with cool dark fissures and sun-warmed exposed edges. Readable authored rock strata, large appealing planar shapes with softly bevelled edges, detailed but no photographic grain. Entire isolated ridge centered in a 3/4 orthographic studio view, neutral light grey background. One reusable modular rock, no island, no circular base, no water, no trees, no text.

assets.name: sea-arch
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated game-optimized 3D coastal rock arch. An asymmetric TROPICAL VOLCANIC SEA ARCH formed by two strongly buttressed weathered basalt legs and an irregular natural stone bridge, a very clear large open hole through the middle. Wide squat leg on one side, slender tilted column on the other. Fluted tan-grey cliff faces, cool dark recesses, beveled angular ledges, emerald moss and bright green grass capping the top and crevices. About 20m wide, 15m high, 10m deep. Polished hand-sculpted adventure-game style, broad shapes and tasteful strata, not a photogrammetry scan. Isolated complete object on neutral light grey, three-quarter orthographic view revealing the hole and thickness, soft studio illumination. No ocean, no island, no ground pedestal, no trees, no building or text.

assets.name: rainforest-tree
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated modular 3D tropical tree for a polished island-map game. An elegant mature rainforest tree with tapered cinnamon-brown buttress-rooted trunk, three visible branching limbs, and seven overlapping asymmetrical crowns made of sculpted broad pointed tropical leaves. Rich deep-green undersides, jade midtones and sunlit yellow-green tips. Foliage reads as tiered spreading leaf clusters with clear leaf shapes and open negative spaces, NOT spheres, bubbles, lollipop bushes or flat discs. Warm sweeping bark grooves, restrained detail and large beautiful color planes. About 12m tall and 10m across. Full tree including roots isolated on neutral light grey, 3/4 orthographic studio rendering, soft even light, no ground base, no scenery, no other objects or text.
